nodes.title: Mount-stiffness rig: optical lever and load steps
nodes.text: T-C4-MOUNT-STIFF read by a laser pointer reflected off a 10 mm mirror bonded to the motor can, onto mm paper on a wall L = 5.0 m away (spot moves 2 theta L); a second mirror on the collar subtracts tube and stub rotation. Spot centre read to +/-0.3 mm from a tripod phone photo against a 1 mm grid. Loads 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 kg at the prop nut. For comparison, C4's two dial gauges (0.01 mm) are 0.030 m apart.
nodes.basis: optical lever is the standard way to read sub-milliradian rotations without a fine gauge; R3: wall 3.0 -> 5.0 m (a corridor) and photo read-out, because C4's need rose to ~1 970 N m/rad (15:01 re-publish) and the spot shrinks with it; laser pointer and mirror are team-owned

nodes.title: Strain-gauge read-out: half bridge (active + dummy) on an HX711 at reduced excitation
nodes.text: 350 ohm foil gauges, gauge factor 2.0 +/-1 %, grid 3 x 2.5 mm (I1 G13). Each active gauge is paired with a dummy gauge bonded on an unloaded offcut of the same material beside the article (temperature compensation), completed by two 350 ohm 0.1 % resistors; one HX711 per bridge (G06 and G12 boards), channel A gain 128. The HX711's 4.3 V excitation is dropped to the bridge through 1.5 kohm in each lead (self-heating on paper over foam). Noise 0.1 uV rms after averaging (2 x the datasheet's 50 nV at 10 SPS for the leads). Shunt calibration: 100 kohm across the dummy arm.
nodes.basis: Vishay TN-502 self-heating guidance: <= 0.05 W/in2 (78 W/m2) on poor heat sinks such as plastics and foam laminates; a dummy gauge on the same substrate cancels apparent strain

nodes.title: Heated aluminium ESC dummy for T-E3-ESC-PAD-CFD
nodes.text: 45 x 20 x 6 mm aluminium block (14.6 g), a 10 ohm 5 W resistor in a 3 mm slot run at 3.0 W (5.5 V, power from V and I on two DMMs, +/-1 %), painted matte black (emissivity 0.90 +/- 0.05, as heat-shrink), on 3 mm XPS (k 0.033 W/m K +/- 10 %) in place of the hook-and-loop so the height above the pad stays the same, held by the flight strap (same 320 mm2 covered). Thermocouple 1 in a hole at the block centre, thermocouple 2 on the pad under the XPS, thermocouple 3 in the inflow; same spool, zero offset checked at ambient (differential +/-0.3 K). Exposed area +/-2.5 % (strap edges).

nodes.title: Thrust stand calibration and noise
nodes.procedure: Card GT-01: dead weights 0.5/1.0/2.0/2.5 kg on the thrust axis via a pulley-free hook, 50/100/200/500 g at the 0.100 m torque arm; 60 s zero-load noise; before and after every session.

nodes.title: Scale and CG-jig calibration
nodes.procedure: Card GT-06/07: 2.000 kg check mass 10 times per scale; 1.000 kg at a ruled x on the jig, recover x; record in logs/T-H1-SCALE-CAL.csv.

nodes.title: Restraint pull before props-on runs
nodes.procedure: Card GT-13: spring scale (or the lever frame) on each strap to the per-strap force, no slip at the table anchor.

nodes.title: Restrained four-motor run (CR-A2-25)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-13: aircraft strapped at the four root eyes after T-H1-RESTRAINT-PULL; fresh pack; QSTABILIZE, 2 s full throttle: BAT.Curr <= 100 A, each ESC rpm <= the cap (Q_M_SPIN_MAX 0.84), per-motor current <= 25 A from ESC telemetry; then 30 s at hover throttle for compassmot (T-F3-COMPASSMOT).

nodes.title: Pack retention pull with a dummy pack (GT-10)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-10: pack-size plywood/sand dummy at the heaviest GT-05 pack mass, strapped as flown; pull CL-H1-PACK-PULL-F in +-x, +-y, +z with jugs over a pulley or a luggage scale, 10 s each; slip <= 5 mm, hatch stays closed. Never a LiPo.

nodes.title: Arm refusal and kill switch, props off (GT-12)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-12: arm refused with each failed pre-arm check; kill switch at 50 % throttle, 5 trials, switch edge to all RCOU at disarm in the log <= CL-H1-ESTOP-ACCEPT.

nodes.title: Coupon lever calibration, both holes
nodes.procedure: Card GT-15 step 0: tare the lever with the short-side counterweight (jug hook empty, lever level); 3.000 kg check mass at the 15:1 clevis, balance with water at the jug hook, ratio = 3.000 / jug mass, 3x, within 2 % of 15.0; same with 2.000 kg at the 9:1 clevis, within 2 % of 9.0. Then a 20 kg jug on the 15:1 hole against a steel bar coupon for 60 s: no crack at the plates, no bolt set.

nodes.title: Readout checks: optical lever, tube deflection and twist, tap acquisition, inclinometer, strain-gauge bridges, ESC-dummy thermocouples
nodes.procedure: Optical lever: 1.00 mm shim under the mirror base edge, spot step matches 2 L t/b; both torsion lasers on the same shim; caliper or dial on a 1.00 mm gauge block; FC raw IMU logs a 200 Hz phone-speaker tone at the right bin; phone inclinometer against a 30 deg printed wedge; each gauge bridge: 60 s zero (2 sigma), 10 min drift <= 5 ue unloaded, shunt step within 1 % of CL-H1-SG-SHUNT; three thermocouples together in still air read within 0.3 K.
